summary: Answer strict RFI/Submittal-to-project-file relationship questions from exact cross-format project evidence.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptable file-grounded support across RFI, Submittal and Email content
The complete workflow index already maps each exact workflow item to its primary and reference files
Every returned relationship must be supported by exact immutable source text
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal use the local shortcut.
Every returned file requires one exact same-identifier non-vision quotation.
Quoted Email history, signatures, filenames, classification labels, duplicate names, more than eight files and more than 32 candidate passages per file fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer applicability, chronology, contractual effect or authority.
